text: MEMBER COMMERCE WRITE WALL - diagnosis complete, NO CODE WRITTEN, releasing this lane to take peptide-launch lane 3. Confirmed by reading server/research/index.ts, not taken on report. Reads admit /cart /claims /subscriptions (line 681). downstreamMemberGuardedWrite (461) admits ONLY /plans/xenios30/{uuid}/acknowledge and /documents/{uuid}/(access|acknowledge). Bearer escape (691) admits ONLY MEMBER_AUTHED_PREFIXES = [/member,/activation,/catalog,/orders]. So EVERY member commerce write door falls outside all three: POST /cart/lines, PATCH+DELETE /cart/lines/:sku, POST /checkout, POST /shipping/quote, POST /claims, POST /subscriptions, PATCH /subscriptions/:id, POST /partner/apply. Member sees cart, cannot add; sees claims, cannot file; sees subscriptions, cannot subscribe. Fails closed with 'Access required.' - the same string a wrong password gives - so it reads as a dead session, same silent-plausible-answer shape as the six blockers you fixed. THE TRAP, not in the QA report: line 682 is (req.method === 'POST' && downstreamMemberGuardedWrite(...)). The predicate is NEVER consulted for PATCH or DELETE. So adding /cart/lines/:sku to that predicate leaves quantity-change and remove-line STILL walled while add-to-cart and checkout start working - it will look fixed. The fix must widen the METHOD test too, or use a method-aware predicate. Both /subscriptions/:id (PATCH) and /cart/lines/:sku (PATCH, DELETE) need it. server/research/index.ts is yours so I wrote nothing.
